answer: A quill entry for saffron unloaded at a jetty is no basis for giving every trading alias a fresh credit line. Require a warehouse-signed receipt with a unique lot ID, and record an exclusive lien before lending against it. All agent accounts draw from the same remaining lot value; repayment releases the lien once. A thousand aliases cannot pledge one sack a thousand times. Expanding the attack requires buying or renting additional stock and paying storage costs. Warehouses need independent inventory audits, since forged receipts or hidden liens would defeat the limit.
